Brand system, version 1.0

The Vector System

One Chevron.
Every Surface.

A refreshed identity for a firm that has delivered quietly for twenty-five years. Everything here grows from one asset XTGlobal already owns: the forward chevron in its logo and on its current site.

01 Logo

The logo is used exactly as supplied, never redrawn, recoloured or cropped. On dark surfaces it always sits on a white plate, which becomes a signature element of the system.

Master Lockup
On Dark: White Plate
Clear Space & Construction
XX

X equals the chevron height. Minimum 24px on screen, 18mm in print.

Rules
  • ✓Full colour on White or Cloud. White plate on Navy, Midnight and photography.
  • ✓Header lockup online; master lockup with tagline in print and footers.
  • ✕No recolouring, outlines, shadows, or stretching.
  • ✕Never placed directly on Vector Sky or busy patterns.

02 The Vector Chevron

Taken from xtg-motif.svg on the current XTGlobal site and echoing the logo's chevron. It is the seed of every pattern, the avatar and the app icon, so the logo itself never needs to be touched.

04 Typography

One family does everything. Plus Jakarta Sans at medium weight with tight tracking carries headlines; the same family at small sizes, in sentence case, carries labels and data with tabular figures. Open source (SIL OFL) with Latin Extended coverage for multilingual launch.

05 Pattern Library

Eight generative patterns, all built from the chevron and drawn in code, so they scale to any size and stay crisp. Each one explains something about how XTGlobal works. Hover a card for its use.

Signal Burst. One source, many reach-points: hero backgrounds, covers, the GCC launch.

01Signal Burst

Forward Field. Momentum toward a goal: section backgrounds, progress, transitions.

02Forward Field

Throughput. Volume and capacity: stats, managed services, toll and transaction stories.

03Throughput

Ramp. Scale-up and launch countdowns: GCC timelines, investor results, estimators.

04Ramp

Halftone Chevron. Many people, one direction: teams, talent, the guide card.

05Halftone Chevron

Supergraphic. The chevron at building scale: covers, photography crops, contact.

06Supergraphic

Slipstream. Steady handover: modernization, migrations, insights thumbnails.

07Slipstream

Orbit. Coverage across time zones: delivery band, campus and office diagrams.

08Orbit

06 Vector, the Guide

An original avatar built from two chevrons: the sky outline is XTGlobal's knowledge, the copper chevron is the answer moving toward you. It never has a face and never pretends to be a person.

States, delivered as SVG and Lottie
IdleFront chevron drifts forward, 3.2s loop
ListeningBack chevron pulses while you type
ThinkingBoth chevrons travel, 0.9s loop
SpeakingCopper core pulses as text streams
HandoffTurns sky when passing to a person

08 Photography

Architecture, never handshakes. Upward angles, converging lines that echo the chevron, cool light, slightly desaturated and graded toward navy. People appear only as small figures for scale.

Hero, glass towers from below
Campus, facade at dusk
Bridges, for logistics
Glass ceilings, for healthcare
Structure at night

Grade

Saturation 70%, contrast up 15%, shadows pushed toward #0A1B36.

Light

Overcast day or blue hour. Sky-blue highlights from glass, no warm sunsets.

Angle

Looking up or straight along a structure, so lines converge forward.

Never

Handshakes, posed teams, clip art, surreal composites or neon glow.
